# balena_device_config_variable (Resource)

Manages a device config variable (the `device_config_variable` resource of the `/v7` API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_device_config_variable" "example" {
  device_id = 123456
  name      = "BALENA_HOST_CONFIG_gpu_mem"
  value     = "example-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `device` (API field `device`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) API field `name` (short text). Name rules from the API's /config/vars: must not match `^[\d:]|[^A-Za-z0-9_:]`; must not be `BALENA`, `RESIN`, `USER`; must start with `BALENA_` or `RESIN_`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `value` (String) API field `value` (text). At most 372340 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the device config variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import balena_device_config_variable.example 123456
```
